data.headline: CTO | Entrepreneur & Researcher
data.about:
Visionary Chief Technology Officer with over 20 years of experience driving large-scale digital transformations and fostering innovation across diverse industries, including IT management consultancy, banking, aviation, finance, telecom, government, and startups.

Known for building and leading high-performance teams, I specialize in leveraging emerging technologies such as Generative AI (GenAI), multi-agent systems, cloud architectures, and modern software engineering practices to deliver substantial business growth and operational efficiencies. My approach combines strategic insight with practical execution, resulting in measurable improvements and industry-recognised outcomes.

Key achievements include:
- Successfully leading digital transformations that have delivered annual business growth ranging from 30% to 100% across multiple organisations.

- Serving as the chief architect for significant industry-wide initiatives such as BPAY Osko (processing $344B in transactions), ANZ Bank Payment Gateway, and major digital transformation programs at Qantas and Sydney Airport.

- Founding L-Earn.io, a generative AI-driven educational startup, securing partnerships and launch and validation of our product

I thrive on innovation, strategic problem-solving, and empowering teams to exceed expectations and deliver solutions that align technology directly with business objectives. Passionate about thought leadership and academic contribution, I actively publish and speak on topics including GenAI, SRE transformation, and IT agility.

Let's connect to explore how technology can drive your organisation's next stage of growth and innovation.

description.text:
Partnering with clients across all sectors to shape and deliver technology strategies and AI-powered transformations that enhance business and commercial outcomes, modernise service delivery, and improve customer and citizen experiences.

As the Wipro Innovation Network (WIN) Leader, I help organisations move from ideas to impact through collaborative, AI‑powered innovation leveraging frontier capabilities such as Agentic Enterprise, Autonomous Systems and Robotics, Quantum Computing and Blockchain.

By orchestrating co‑creation across Wipro’s global innovation labs, partner ecosystem, start‑ups and academia, I support the design, incubation and scaling of solutions that address real‑world business challenges and create sustainable competitive advantages across industries.

description.text: Partnering with state and federal agencies, universities, and health & aged care providers to shape and deliver technology strategies and AI-powered transformations that enhance policy outcomes, modernise service delivery, and improve citizen experiences.

L-earn.io is an EdTech start-up dedicated to creating a marketplace and a GenAI Powered learning management platform aimed at personalised learning and enhancing individuals' learning experience.

Currently, our focus is on the K-12 age group, addressing two primary challenges faced by parents and students:
-  Tired of spending money, attending courses and training, and not getting their desired outcome!
- To make kids engaged in learning and practice to maximise their knowledge and learning potential

We are in the process of developing our first minimum viable product (MVP) to test our hypothesis.

Please feel free to contact me if you are interested in this topic or would like to get involved.

description.text:
Leading the IBM / Red Hat business group with the focus on Hybrid cloud and Mainframe modernisation. This involved building a new practice/business group within Accenture A/NZ from the ground up to bring multi-cloud technologies and practices to customers using the award-winning Opensource Red Hat, IBM technologies, and the Accenture globally recognised business and change leadership.

Our joint focus areas involve Multi and Hybrid Cloud transformations, IBM & Red Hat technology modernisation (Data Platforms, legacy Applications, Mainframe) towards cloud-native and multi-cloud solutions, Customer Engagement solutions using IBM Watson and Opensource technologies, and finally customer capability uplift to DevOps and SRE to respond to their business needs quickly.

Applying these to the legacy Mainframe environment, we find a lot of opportunities to modernise the s/w packages used on today's Z/OS environments, transform and move off workloads that do not belong to the mainframe, and use Mainframes as part of the Hybrid cloud strategy to bring considerable savings on IT on-prem energy consumption and IT run cost.

experiences.title: Head - Open Innovation Labs and Architecture Practice - A/NZ
experiences.subtitle: Red Hat . undefined
experiences.caption: May 2018 - Feb 2021 · 2 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
Built and led a new practice @ Red Hat A/NZ. The Red Hat Open Innovation Labs is a specialised practice that helps customers to transform their Dev & Ops teams to SRE and Agile Product teams. 

What you get at the end: a team enabled on modern multi-cloud software engineering practices to design, develop, deploy and manage Microservice architecture & GitOps on Kubernates, The Continous Integration and deployment pipelines, effective LEAN and Agile adoption and a real workng software. 

Some of the activities:
- Build and lead the Practice in A/NZ including recruiting and leading the architects, developers and agile coaches  
- Building and managing the sales pipeline
- Delivery management of transformational lab residencies 
- Leading presales workshops, discoveries and DevOps capability assessment and ROI calculation 
- Capability building and service development for the practice (Open Practice Library) 
- Leading marketing and partnership strategies for the practice

Key achievements: 
- Creation of a strong practice with an awesome team, winning multiple awards
- Successful delivery of lab residencies with major customers - global case studies (ANZ NZ Bank - CIO Magazine Article, etc.)
- Building a strong pipeline of opportunities
- Building new service offerings: IT Automation residency for OPS teams (SRE transformation), Presales Impact discovery and ROI modeling
- Enablement of Sales and Presales team with new transformational offerings
- Leading many high impact marketing events such as Gartner Lab booth

Built and led the company with a few lines of business:  solution and enterprise architecture consultancy and investment in three start-up businesses using our own offshore development team. 
 
In our two decades of history, we have helped a variety of organisations such as Qantas, Smartgroup, Sydney Airport, NSW Police, BPay / Card Link (NPP Initiative), ING Bank (service layer design and advisory), Fujitsu, RedHat, Plutonic Zoo, Lucca, Salt Technologies to be best at what they do.

What we do:
- Lead Enterprise, solution and program architecture
- transformation of architecture, development and OPS teams to modern Architecture, DevOps & SRE teams
- Multi-cloud adoption planning and architecture
- Enterprise architecture planning such as application modernisation assessment and roadmap, monolith to microservices planning, mainframe modernisation (NSW Police COPS)
- Design sprint coordination with Lean Canvas and ROI modeling 
- Vendor and Technology selection 
- Delivery partnership with start-up companies

description.text:
An engagement to define the customer experience target architecture, architectural roadmaps and   capability gaps that impact the realisation of CX strategy and objectives. 

The output guided the CX investment across all CX Product streams as well as setting the direction for all programs and product streams to deliver and reuse the key CX components.

The work involved CX platforms positioning, Customer API definitions and customer data management, e.g. positioning of Salesforce (Sales and Service), Marketing Automation platforms (Adobe & Lighthouse), architecting the Next Best Action, Customer 360˚ view, Customer social channels and the AI/Chatbots, particulalry for the call centre transformation.

Additionally, I partnered with the Salesforce Automation business owner and created and chaired the Salesforce Architecture forum at Qantas to improve the platform governance and roadmap development  for the platform across the organisation.
